cues.text: Wrap the yarn over your hook first — back to front
Now go into stitch 2 — under both top loops
The hook pokes out the back
Wrap the yarn over your hook — back to front
Pull it back through — 3 loops on your hook
Wrap the yarn over again — back to front
Pull through 2 — 2 loops left on your hook
Wrap the yarn over again — back to front
Your double crochet — a tall post on stitch 2
